forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Time to first token for tool-call-only generation calls (first streamed fragment of any kind)
+---
+From foundationmodelsacpagent-a5, real MLX run router-telemetry-16 (django__django-13447, router 31eab019). 45 of 105 generation_call spans have no generation.time_to_first_token_ms or generation.decode_ms, and no generation.call.* metric or tokens_per_second point. 42 of them are finish_reason "completed" with tool_call_count 1, and 3 have tool_call_count 0. Their median tokens.out is 326 and median duration 8.4 s. The transcript does not grow until the end of a tool-call output, so the transcript-growth first-token detector (ab662cd6) never fires. About 700 s of 1800 s of model time has no split.
+
+- [ ] Failing test first: a tool-call-only call that streams arguments records TTFT and decode time
+- [ ] Measure the first token from the first streamed fragment or snapshot of any kind (text, reasoning, tool-call arguments), not only from transcript growth
+- [ ] Always record the total call time. Mark calls where no first token was seen (e.g. span attribute generation.first_token_seen=false), so a missing split is never read as zero
\ No newline at end of file
